transcript.why: The reply says the video was not made because the Magic Hour account has no credits left. It does not make a video, and it does not ask the user to approve spending. It names the blockers (no credits, a paid plan or waiting for free credits) and says it will retry once credits return. This matches the "needs a paid plan" case of cannot, not delivered, approval, or question.
